stem: The masses, in kilograms, of chemicals $A$ and $B$ produced per day by a factory are modelled by the independent random variables $X$ and $Y$ respectively, where $X \sim \text{N}(10.3, 5.76)$ and $Y \sim \text{N}(11.4, 9.61)$. The income generated by the chemicals is \$2.50 per kilogram for $A$ and \$3.25 per kilogram for $B$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the mean and variance of the daily income generated by chemical $A$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability that, on a randomly chosen day, the income generated by chemical $A$ is greater than the income generated by chemical $B$.
